title: Mixed numbers
subtitle: Explore the idea with a visual model.
learning_objective: Convert between mixed numbers and improper fractions.

sections.heading: Make sense of it
sections.body: A mixed number combines wholes and a fraction. To convert it, multiply wholes by the denominator, add the numerator, and keep the denominator.

sections.heading: Build a picture
sections.caption: Each row represents the same-sized whole.

sections.reasoning: Each step keeps the meaning of the whole and its equal parts clear.

sections.heading: Watch for this
sections.body: Do not add the whole number directly to the numerator before making equal parts.

sections.heading: Your turn
sections.prompt: What is 1 2/5 as an improper fraction?
sections.hint: Use the visual and the worked steps above before choosing.
